# ca-certificates

`ca-certificates` is maintained in Alpine's `ca-certificates` repository;
`certdata.txt` is the Mozilla CA certificate bundle whose header carries the
MPL-2.0 notice, and the Alpine scripts are distributed under the package's
declared `MPL-2.0 AND MIT` expression (see `APKBUILD-3.24-stable`). The MPL-2.0
text is included as `MPL-2.0.txt` (copied verbatim from
`third_party/licenses/alpine/common/MPL-2.0.txt`); the repository publishes no
separate MIT text file.
